totals_note: elapsed includes concurrent CPU work and GPU waiting; measured phase totals are not additive wall time; incomplete cache trials excluded from completed scoring totals
component_notes: CPU cohort NPY image_cache_seconds includes exclusive cache-lock waiting, which was not separately measured; JPEG decode occurs inside upload_seconds, while its prepare only indexes levels. Upload also includes array conversion/copy on CPU and host-to-device transfer on GPU. Arithmetic excludes this interval. The bounded JPEG LRU may decode a photo again across row blocks after eviction; camera visits and actual decodes are recorded separately. Timings from different target groups are not controlled speedup comparisons.
